# Pixoate

> > Pixoate is a free AI-powered photo editor offering background removal, upscaling, effects, and social media optimization tools entirely in the browser.

Pixoate provides an all-in-one suite of online photo editing tools powered by AI, with specialized features for e-commerce, social media, and professional use cases. The platform supports multiple image formats (PNG, JPG, WebP, HEIC, GIF) and includes preset dimensions for popular platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn.

## Key Topics

- AI photo editing
- Background removal
- Image upscaling
- Social media optimization
- Instagram resizing
- Image compression
- Format conversion
- Photo effects
- Batch processing
- Browser-based editor
- PNG/JPG/WebP support
- E-commerce tools
- Profile pictures
- Reverse image search
- Passport photos

## Core AI Features

- [AI Photo Editor - Remove Background & Upscale Images Free](https://pixoate.com): Pixoate homepage: AI-powered photo editor with background removal, upscaling, resizing.
- [Remove Background AI - Transparent PNG for Amazon & LinkedIn](https://pixoate.com/remove-background): AI background removal tool for transparent PNG creation and e-commerce use.
- [AI Image Upscaler - Enhance Photos 2x 4x Free No Watermark](https://pixoate.com/upscale): AI image upscaler enhancing photos 2x-4x without quality loss or watermarks.
- [Photo to Cartoon AI - Turn Pictures into Cartoon Style Free](https://pixoate.com/photo-cartoon): AI photo-to-cartoon converter for avatars and creative social media content.

## Social Media Tools

- [Instagram Photo Resizer - 1080x1080 Posts & 9:16 Stories](https://pixoate.com/instagram-photo-resize): Instagram-specific photo resizer for posts, stories, and reels with smart padding.
- [Resize Images for Instagram 1080x1080 & Social Media Free](https://pixoate.com/resize-image): Image resizer for Instagram, Facebook, Twitter with preset social media dimensions.
- [Facebook Business Page Cover 820x312 - Marketing Ads Resize](https://pixoate.com/facebook-photo-resize): Facebook-specific resizer for business covers, ads, posts, and profile pictures.
- [Circle Crop Tool - Perfect Round Profile Pictures Free](https://pixoate.com/crop-circle-image): Circle crop tool for profile pictures on LinkedIn, Discord, WhatsApp.
- [Discord Stickers & Gaming Avatar Shape Crop - Heart Star](https://pixoate.com/crop-by-shape): Shape cropper for Discord stickers, gaming avatars with heart, star shapes.

## Image Editing & Enhancement

- [47+ Free Photo Effects & Filters - Apply Online Instantly](https://pixoate.com/photo-effects): Library of 47+ professional photo effects including cinematic, vintage, HDR filters.
- [Crop Images to Perfect Size - Square, Custom Dimensions](https://pixoate.com/crop-image): Image cropper with preset ratios for Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn.
- [Compress Images Under 100KB for Email & Web - Free Tool](https://pixoate.com/compress-image): Image compressor reducing JPG, PNG file sizes by 80% for email and web.
- [Add Border to Photos - Custom Frames & Colors Online](https://pixoate.com/photo-border): Photo border and frame tool with 50+ customizable styles for Instagram.
- [Rotate & Flip Images 90° 180° 270° - Free Online Tool](https://pixoate.com/rotate-image): Image rotation and orientation fix tool for mobile and desktop photos.
- [Flip Mirror Images Horizontally & Vertically - Free](https://pixoate.com/flip-mirror-image): Image flip tool for horizontal and vertical mirroring of selfies and photos.

## Format & Conversion Tools

- [Convert Images - HEIC to JPG, PNG, WebP Format Converter](https://pixoate.com/convert-image): Multi-format image converter supporting HEIC, JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF conversions.
- [Portrait to Landscape Converter - Presentation Banners](https://pixoate.com/landscape-portrait): Orientation converter for transforming portrait to landscape for presentations.

## Specialized Photo Solutions

- [US Passport Photo 2x2 & Visa Application Photo Maker Online](https://pixoate.com/passport-photo-resize): Official passport photo resizer for US, UK, EU, Canada with government specs.
- [Copyright Check Reverse Image Search - Find Stolen Photos](https://pixoate.com/reverse-image-search): Reverse image search across Google, Bing, Yandex for copyright verification.
